title: Pollen Metabarcoding Protocol
author: Tomasz Suchan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sp2edqe

steps.title: Extract Pollen from Butterfly
steps.instruction: Vortex the butterfly in 50 μl of water containing 0.1% SDS. Include an isolation blank at this stage.

steps.title: Prepare First PCR Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a reaction mix containing molecular grade water, Phire Plant Direct PCR mix, ITS2-S2F primer, and ITS2-4R primer.

steps.title: Perform First PCR
steps.instruction: Combine the sample and mix, then run the thermal cycler program.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 μl of the Phire Plant Direct sample buffer to the mix
Spin at max speed for 2 min
Run PCR program: 30 s denaturation at 98°C; 12 cycles of (denaturation at 98°C for 10 s and combined annealing/extension at 72°C for 30 s); final extension at 72°C for 5 min

steps.title: Purify and Verify First PCR Product
steps.instruction: Clean the PCR product and verify the profile.

substeps.instruction: Perform AMPure purification with a 1x ratio and elute in 10 μl

steps.title: Prepare Second PCR Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a reaction mix containing molecular grade water, Q5 reaction buffer, dNTPs (25 mM each), and Q5 Hot Start polymerase.

steps.title: Perform Second PCR
steps.instruction: Combine the template and mix, then run the thermal cycler program.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 μl of the sample to 49 μl of the mix (use water for blanks; include a 'PCR blank')
Run PCR program: initial denaturation at 98°C for 5 min; 20 cycles of (denaturation at 98°C for 40 s, annealing at 49°C for 40 s, and elongation at 72°C for 40 s); final extension at 72°C for 5 min

steps.title: Purify Second PCR Product
steps.instruction: Clean the second PCR product using AMPure purification with a 1x ratio and elute in 100 μl.

steps.title: Prepare Sequencing Library
steps.instruction: Prepare the final template for sequencing using indexed primers.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 μl of the template to 7 μl of the mix
Add 1 μl of each 5 uM primer (forward and reverse), using a different pair of indexed primers for each sample

steps.title: Quantify and Sequence
steps.instruction: Verify the library quality and proceed to sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Check concentration using Qubit and profile using Tapestation/Fragment Analyzer
Add 15% PhiX to the sequencing run
